decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting remains closely tied to the firm's specialist, standards-intensive marine know-how, so accumulated learning since launch makes continued refinement more likely than withdrawal.

The spring-balanced desk lamp draws on the firm's ergonomic office-lighting knowledge, but because it is less central to the firm's system-solution focus it remains a plausible candidate for later portfolio pruning if returns disappoint.

A general interior lighting luminaire sits in the heart of the firm's existing indoor-lighting capabilities and channels, so feedback can be absorbed and translated into incremental improvements at relatively low risk.

Although the marine HMI searchlight benefits from related marine expertise, its weaker fit with the firm's LED- and sustainability-oriented development path makes redeploying resources to more aligned products the more likely choice.
The marine searchlight is strongly connected to the firm's robust specialist-lighting, certification and demanding transport-application capabilities, which supports retaining and improving the line.
